title: Easy to use but....
text: Easy to use but..... These are definitely a Wilton product which is in my opinion a good baking product they are easy to use and easy to clean but I am unimpressed with the shapes. I was hoping that they were going to be smaller and a more noticeable shape the only one that you can tell is a dog type is the bone.
